outcome: The coupled public PlayerClient, bridge response, display/retrieval, CLI and guidance surfaces now provide direct bounded wait/move operations, monotonic idempotent collection and restart recovery, safe read-only retrieval while collection is pending, opt-in routine diagnostics, and consistent source/action selectors with stable-identity deltas and pageable catalogs.
summary: The implementation uses the existing durable request/response artifacts and client state only; it adds no session database, polling loop, scripted player or scenario mutation. Collection reuses an already recorded latest result; recovery reconstructs only a genuinely outstanding request after confirming no retained response exists, never resubmitting. An older retained response stays read-only and names its exact retrieval route, so it cannot roll back newer display or action authority. The compact display now makes its retained response roots explicit, surfaces changed stable identities before unchanged previews, reports cursor-based message additions without grouping them away, and pages large action catalogs while preserving controls. The 115 focused tests cover success/rejection duplicate collection, lost client state, monotonic A-to-B recovery, timeout, stale grants, finish/reentry behavior, safe reads during pending collection, direct request construction, large menus, sixth-entity change, message cursors, response diagnostics and exact retrieval.
material_changes: Extended PlayerClient and play_cli with direct bounded wait/move arguments and monotonic idempotent collect/resume: only a genuinely outstanding request can be restored, the latest collected receipt can be returned from cache, and older recorded receipts stay read-only without a transport resend or state mutation.
Moved controls, inspect and messages onto the existing read-only route; messages retain the last displayed receipt only while its successor operation is pending and never reuse its input grant.
Made bridge startup diagnostics opt-in on ordinary successful response-status calls while preserving automatic failure diagnostics and exact artifact retrieval.

Unified gameplay display selectors and large-catalog behavior with cockpit evidence, added stable identity entity deltas and cursor-based ungrouped message additions, and updated executable usage/search guidance.
Recorded a synthetic public response-plus-action-page stdout measurement with its stated limits.
